assets.what: The valley floor: pale limestone rubble under turf, no surface.
The valley floor with the turf on top: the path the hiker walks.
The wall built across the mouth of the shelter, with its door. The way in.
Bedrock of the shelter, bedded limestone, no surface.
Bedrock with the floor surface on top.
One horse of the frieze in high relief. Its back is the ledge. All ten are this sprite, and so is the cast.
A bison of the frieze in low relief: lines in the wall, not a ledge.
The cast of the 1911 burial, lying at the foot of the frieze.
The workman of 1909 with his pick. Two frames: raised, down.
The deposit the excavation left in place: layered sediment, no surface.
The deposit with its cut top.
A block of the overhang, on its way down. Limestone, one fresh face where it parted.
